completeness_contract.COMPLETE: all seven fields use eligible completed periods, pass strict cutoff and stale validation, preserve raw evidence, and normalize successfully
completeness_contract.COMPLETE_WITH_GOVERNED_MISSING: not available until a future frozen source-calendar rule explains normal closure; never API failure, timestamp ambiguity, stale data, or implementation failure
completeness_contract.INCOMPLETE: required for unresolved calendar/availability, stale data, raw-evidence absence, source failure/timeout, parser/normalization failure, or silent field absence

official_evidence.deterministic_summary: The observations response supplies date, value, realtime_start, and realtime_end. Vintage dates and real-time periods can select data as known on dates, but the observation schema does not provide a publication-time-of-day field.
official_evidence.supports: FRED observation schema and vintage/revision capability
official_evidence.title: St. Louis Fed Web Services: fred/series/observations

official_evidence.deterministic_summary: The series page identifies DGS2 as a daily, not-seasonally-adjusted H.15 Selected Interest Rates series and displays missing observations as a dot. A page-level current update display is not a historical per-observation availability timestamp.
official_evidence.supports: DGS2 series frequency and source-release linkage
official_evidence.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 2-Year Constant Maturity

official_evidence.deterministic_summary: The series page identifies DGS10 as a daily, not-seasonally-adjusted H.15 Selected Interest Rates series and displays missing observations as a dot. A page-level current update display is not a historical per-observation availability timestamp.
official_evidence.supports: DGS10 series frequency and source-release linkage
official_evidence.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity

official_evidence.deterministic_summary: The endpoint returns daily, weekly, or monthly OHLC-style historical data for a symbol, including forex and indices. The documented daily description does not establish a UTC publication instant, completed-bar flag, or historical availability timestamp for an individual row.
official_evidence.supports: EODHD EOD route cadence and OHLC bar content
official_evidence.title: End-Of-Day Historical Stock Market Data API

official_evidence.deterministic_summary: The official support page identifies the EOD historical route for FOREX symbols. It does not define an intraday availability field for a daily row.
official_evidence.title: List of Supported FOREX Currencies

official_evidence.deterministic_summary: The endpoint provides end-of-day historical open, high, low, close, volume, and related daily fields. Its documented daily date/price content does not establish a source availability timestamp, current-day completion indicator, or a calendar for DX-Y.NYB and CLUSD.
official_evidence.supports: FMP historical EOD route cadence and OHLC content
official_evidence.title: Stock Price and Volume Data API

implementation_authorization.reason: The final contract did not freeze; earlier inactive implementation inputs remain unchanged and unactivated.

lead_time.reason: Hard per-route timeout authority is absent and none of the seven routes has a strict pre-cutoff availability rule.

numeric_only_treatment.categorical_directions: omitted; no RISING/FALLING/FLAT threshold is introduced
numeric_only_treatment.change_24h: numeric only; requires two eligible completed observations selected in ascending source-period order
numeric_only_treatment.change_5d: numeric only; requires the latest eligible observation and the fifth preceding eligible source observation
numeric_only_treatment.latest_value: use only the latest eligible completed observation after availability and stale authority close
numeric_only_treatment.missing_prior_observation: UNAVAILABLE; do not substitute zero or a non-governed date
numeric_only_treatment.rounding_order: calculate from normalized source-unit values; round only at final Pack serialization under the frozen construction contract

stale_authority.reason: Every frozen route lacks a governed completed-period and observation-availability rule; expected periods, source-closed classification, and missed-period stale bounds cannot be frozen without inventing calendars.

timeout_authority.accepted_infrastructure_inspected: authoritative_provider_bridge.js hard_timeout_seconds applies to forecast provider calls, not the frozen FRED/EODHD/FMP source routes
timeout_authority.reason: No accepted source-route client configuration or governing source-operation contract sets a hard timeout. Choosing a value would be a new ungoverned parameter, so no maximum duration can be derived.
timeout_authority.safe_resume: STATUS_UNKNOWN remains non-reusable until a future exact request journal proves a complete raw response was persisted.
